name: Front
one_liner: Front is a shared inbox and omnichannel customer communication platform with a REST API for integrating with external systems.
auth_notes: Front recommends implementing OAuth when feasible, which has the additional benefit of building within our application framework.
access_notes: You can create a developer account by signing up here. You’ll get access to a free developer environment that will provide everything you need to begin building with our APIs.

extras.rate_limits: Front's rate limit is per company, not per token — so every token and integration on the account draws from the same pool.

evidence.snippet: The Core API uses Bearer tokens to authenticate its user.
evidence.subject: own-domain

evidence.snippet: Front's MCP server (`mcp.frontapp.com/mcp`) lets AI agents act on Front conversation data using a single OAuth-authenticated endpoint.
evidence.subject: own-domain

evidence.snippet: The Front Core API is a RESTful, JSON-over-HTTPS API — Front calls it their "primary backend API." You make standard HTTP requests — `GET` to read, `POST` to create, `PUT`/`PATCH` to update, `DELETE` to remove — against resource URLs, and you get JSON back.
evidence.subject: third-party-confirmed

evidence.snippet: Once your integration has been technically approved, our team will use the image and marketing details you submit in the form to launch your integration with a dedicated landing page on our website and in our app.
evidence.subject: own-domain
